# three filters, two pipes; each stage knows only the data shape
LOG = ["10.0.0.1 404 /a", "10.0.0.2 200 /b", "10.0.0.1 404 /c", "10.0.0.3 404 /d"]

def select_404(rows):            # filter: keep the 404 lines
    return [r for r in rows if " 404 " in r]

def take_ip(rows):               # filter: project the client ip
    return [r.split()[0] for r in rows]

def tally(ips):                  # filter: aggregate per ip
    counts = {}
    for ip in ips:
        counts[ip] = counts.get(ip, 0) + 1
    return counts

stage1 = select_404(LOG)
stage2 = take_ip(stage1)
stage3 = tally(stage2)
print("1:", stage1)
print("2:", stage2)
print("3:", stage3)

RULES = [
    ("pipe-filter", ("stream",)),
    ("client-server", ("shared", "remote")),
    ("mvc", ("ui",)),
    ("shared-data", ("shared",)),     # add more rules and scenarios
]

def select(traits):
    for name, needs in RULES:
        if all(traits.get(t, False) for t in needs):
            return name
    return "layered"

print(select({"stream": True, "ui": False, "shared": False, "remote": False}))
print(select({"ui": True, "stream": False, "shared": False, "remote": False}))
print(select({"shared": True, "remote": False, "stream": False, "ui": False}))
